description: SHA-256 of the vendored PDF.js files that the build copies unmodified from node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build into pdfjs/ (design decision 25). check-urls and check-fetch skip a built file only when its hash is listed here, so the reviewed upstream code is trusted as a unit and any change to it is scanned. Update the hashes together with the pinned version of pdfjs-dist.
